newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Seven killed in Honduras family massacre.
newsitem.headline: Seven killed in Honduras family massacre.

text.p: Gunmen killed seven people, six of them from a single family, in the northern Honduran city of San Pedro Sula late Monday, police said on Tuesday.
One gunman told a radio station following his arrest that he was drunk at the time of the killings and had a personal dispute with one of the victims.
"I can't talk about it...I was drunk," Juan Carlos Castro said.

Police said six of the victims were from the Pavon Deras family, including a mother and father, their son and pregnant daughter-in-law and a granddaughter. Another of the dead was identified as Nahun Rodriguez.
The killings took place in a poor neighbourhood of San Pedro Sula, about 100 miles (160 km) north of the capital Tegucigalpa.
Radio reports said several other people were arrested with Castro, some of them suspected of having taken part in a recent bank robbery. No other details were immediately available.
